subject: math
question: 证明不等式： $\left|\frac{\sin x - \sin y}{x - y} -\cos y\right|\leqslant \frac{1}{2}|x - y|,x,y\in (-\infty , + \infty)$
answer: \begin{array}{r l} \left| \frac {\sin x - \sin y}{x - y} - \cos y \right| & = \left| \frac {\left[ \sin y + \cos y \cdot (x - y) - \frac {1}{2} \sin \xi \cdot (x - y) ^ {2} \right] - \sin y}{x - y} - \cos y \right| \\ & = \left| - \frac {1}{2} \sin \xi \cdot (x - y) \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{2} | x - y |. \end{array}

steps.text:
分析 不等式的形式很容易使人想到微分中值定理，由拉格朗日微分中值定理，得

$$
\left| \frac {\sin x - \sin y}{x - y} - \cos y \right| = | \cos \xi - \cos y | = 2 \left| \sin \left(\frac {\xi - y}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac {\xi + y}{2}\right) \right| \leqslant | \xi - y |,
$$

上面不等式没有精确到所要求证明的程度. 因此要想有更精确的估计, 需用泰勒公式.
将 $\sin x$ 在点 $y$ 处展开成一阶泰勒公式，得

$$
\sin x = \sin y + \cos y \cdot (x - y) - \frac {1}{2} \sin \xi \cdot (x - y) ^ {2} (\xi \text {介于} x \text {与} y \text {之间})
$$

solution.final_answer: \begin{array}{r l} \left| \frac {\sin x - \sin y}{x - y} - \cos y \right| & = \left| \frac {\left[ \sin y + \cos y \cdot (x - y) - \frac {1}{2} \sin \xi \cdot (x - y) ^ {2} \right] - \sin y}{x - y} - \cos y \right| \\ & = \left| - \frac {1}{2} \sin \xi \cdot (x - y) \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{2} | x - y |. \end{array}
